name: Ria
source:
Ria is a widower who had lost her husband while she was carrying [url=/c101644]Milo[/url]. She was a brash woman in her youth and had Milo at an early age. Nowadays, she works in numerous shops to support the two of them. She has calmed down compared how she was when she was younger, but some old habits die hard.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/smilingdog/posts/character-intro-53107628]Patreon[/url]]
